expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: Row 3 says 'Search is a clickable `<div>`... can't be reached with Tab... screen readers don't announce it as a control', and row 4 says 'Icon-only controls have no accessible name' and recommends adding `aria-label="Delete"`.

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: Row 8 flags `onPaste={(e) => e.preventDefault()}` as 'Blocking paste', and row 5 says 'Delete runs `onDelete` straight away... with no confirmation'.

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: Row 1 flags `height: '100vh'` and suggests `100dvh`, and row 2 flags 'Fixed to the bottom with no safe-area padding' and suggests `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.
